summary: Early in the coronavirus pandemic, as I sat at home channeling my anxiety into publishing daily essays on this newsletter (a streak I kept up for six weeks), I had a revelation: none of my advice, ideas, or systems really mattered if you didn’t build them on the foundation of a meaningful life. takeaways: Later that summer, when I ​launched my podcast​ , I dedicated a third of my inaugural episode to this concept. (My original tagline: “a show about work, technology, and the deep life.”) Two years later, as we returned to normalcy, I convinced my publisher to let me try writing a book on these ideas.
The Deep Life brings together and significantly expands on my past thinking on this topic.
Who cares about losing yourself to social media or letting work devolve into email whack-a-mole if the world outside of your phone and inbox isn’t that compelling?
